chunks: Are these the ones of whom you swore that God would not reach them with mercy? Enter Paradise; no fear will be upon you, nor will you grieve.

key_terms.أَهَٰؤُلَاءِ: Are these (demonstrative pronoun indicating surprise or emphasis)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic verse where God asks 'Are these the ones...?' regarding mercy and Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate reversal of fortune, where the arrogant disbelievers' confident oaths are proven false as the believers enter Jannah. It serves as a divine rebuke to their false certainty and a promise of ultimate success for the faithful, highlighting the transition from worldly pride to eternal peace.
